output.reason: The proposed exposure checks the Helm values key `kube-gateway.containers`. The values validator found that key in no chart values file of either release [ev-41d780f6ab39][ev-ad95ec08c00b], so "unset" would be true for every environment. That condition is far too broad. The release note [ev-7edf2052e7af] describes a template fix that adds a metrics port to the kube-gateway container spec in the istio-discovery chart, not a values key. It also gives no criteria for which environments use that template, and the render diff that might have shown this failed, so no correct condition follows from the evidence shown.
